sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface immunostaining PME 821.7 ± 238.6 (HA immunostaining, Tedman deep receptor scanning)
sites.rationale: Experimentally validated N-terminal HA epitope insertion (after signal-peptide cleavage where present); surface expression read out by HA immunostaining in Tedman et al. deep receptor scanning.

sources.citation: Tedman et al., Efficient experimental characterization of the GPCRome via deep receptor scanning, Nat Commun 2026 (bioRxiv 2025.09.19.677468, PMC12458215)
sources.claim: N-terminal HA epitope inserted per receptor; surface expression read out by HA immunostaining in a pooled GPCRome deep-receptor-scanning screen.

literature_notes: Two ledger lines were evaluated. L1 (PMC12069643) reports BRIL inserted replacing residues 246-266, described by the authors as 'ICL3'. The computed topology landmarks place residues 244-261 in ICL2 (intracellular) and 262-282 in TM4; residues 246-266 therefore span ICL2 and TM4 — neither extracellular. Regardless of the loop-label discrepancy between the paper and the computed topology, this insertion is not on the extracellular face and cannot support a surface tag site. L2 (PMC3459905) reports a C-myc tag fused to the C-terminus of hNPFFR2; the computed topology places residues 438-522 in the intracellular C-terminal tail. This is a cytoplasmic tag and does not qualify as an extracellular surface site. No ledger line grounds any extracellular insertion in NPFFR2; zero sites is the correct answer.

literature_other_positions.note: BRIL replacing residues 246-266 (paper labels this ICL3; computed topology places 246-261 in ICL2 and 262-266 in TM4) — tolerated for cryo-EM but entirely intracellular/TM, not an extracellular surface site.
C-myc tag fused to the intracellular C-terminus (residues 438-522 are cytoplasmic per computed topology); tolerated for Western blot detection but not an extracellular surface site.
